description: This file contains Orleans grain interface and implementation for programmatic subscription management, including a class for stream identity.

classes.name: ISubscribeGrain
classes.description: Interface defining a grain that can check for subscription manager availability.

classes.name: SubscribeGrain
classes.description: Implementation of ISubscribeGrain that provides method to verify subscription manager existence.

classes.name: FullStreamIdentity
classes.description: Serializable class representing a full stream identity with provider name, GUID, and namespace.

methods.name: CanGetSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Checks if the specified stream provider has a subscription manager available.

methods.name: FullStreamIdentity
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream identity with GUID, namespace, and provider name.

methods.name: operator StreamId
methods.description: Implicit conversion operator to create a StreamId from a FullStreamIdentity.
